# 11. Facilitator {.unnumbered}

There will be no mindset this week. Instead, you will prepare to facilitate a discussion with
your team on their (past/current) team problems and (future) team aspirations using caring
communication.

## Reflect and Plan

::: {.callout-warning}
## Journal
- **Plan:** What past or current problems and future aspirations do you want to surface with
  your team, and how will you use caring communication to facilitate that conversation?
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## UGPM Meeting
Prepare and practice facilitating your team discussion, drawing on the caring-communication
skills from Week 7, Communication Style.
:::
